{{Quote|A well-built sniper rifle is a beautiful thing. Ours has two separate levels of zoom: 'Up-close-and-personal' and 'Hello-you're-dead.'&thinsp;|[[Sev/Legends|Sev]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
'''Sniper rifles''' were long-range weapons, either [[Slugthrower/Legends|projectile]] or, more commonly, [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-based (these were also called '''sniper blaster rifles''').<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> The purpose of a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] rifle was to kill a target at extreme distances. A sniper blaster rifle fired a long beam of energy, capable of killing with a single headshot.

Sniper blaster rifles often had a [[bipod]] and [[Scope/Legends|targeting scope]] mounted on them.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

==History==
[[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] often used projectile sniper rifles to take potshots at [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]]. A sniper rifle was used by [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] to destroy her [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]] droid during the plot to assassinate [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Another was used by [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] during the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]] to take out [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], and an attempt to kill Senator Amidala. A sniper rifle was used in a failed attempt to assassinate [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by a [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] assassin. The bounty hunter Jango Fett attempted to collect a bounty by killing a clone deserter with his son Boba Fett, but failed. The [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] was the maker of the notorious [[DXR-6 disruptor rifle]], which, when fitted with a zoom scope, became an especially deadly sniper rifle.

In the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]] was notable for their highly accurate sniper weapons.
